rules: A dependency without at least one concrete current Biology consumer is not retained.

Retained in the integrated candidate does not mean permanent architecture: Mod Settings, ArchiveXL and RED4ext remain REMOVE/RETHINK routes with current feature/activation ownership rather than obsolete lane ownership.
The only directly feature-justified supplemental runtime framework in the current source is redscript.
A future worker requesting a new dependency must identify the exact feature, why vanilla/REDmod/current redscript cannot satisfy it, and the package/install consequence before this graph changes.
Bundled third-party components require pinned version/hash/license/provenance and exact per-file ownership.
No source gameplay/presentation mod may execute or be bundled.
